title: Academic Management System - Lab 3
description: Java-based project developed for Programming Lab III. It features a RESTful API for managing subjects, professors, and students, including full CRUD operations, unit testing and UML diagrams to document the backend architecture.

title: Console-based Strategy Card Game in Java
description: Final project for Programming III. It's a two-player console card game built in Java, where each player competes using characters with distinct attributes. Features include combat logic, exception handling, random character generation, and UML design documentation.

title: Flask Movie API
description: Final project for Programming II at UTN. I built a REST API using Python and Flask to manage a local JSON database of movies. Features include CRUD operations, search engine, pagination, user ratings, and a frontend in HTML/CSS.

title: Animal Nursery Console System
description: Practical project for Programming III, developed in Java. It features a console application that simulates an animal nursery system. Includes class design for various animals and a main nursery class to manage them.

title: Web Portfolio Full-Stack
description: Development of a professional portfolio's user interface using Angular, HTML and CSS, as part of the Argentina Programa. It features components such as personal presentation, experience, education and integration with back-end via HTTP services. Backend development with Java and Spring Boot, it includes RESTful endpoints for user authentication and managing personal information.

title: World Cup Statistics - Flexbox Dashboard
description: Final project for Programming Lab II. A general dashboard layout designed using HTML and CSS with Flexbox. Includes side navigation, profile panel, featured content sections and a responsive layout for desktop.

title: Personal Portfolio in React
description: Web application built with React, Vite and Bootstrap, structured using Atomic Design principles. Features animations, visual effects, multi-language support, modular sections and is deployed on Vercel.

title: La Cuponera - FrontEnd
description: Team-built coupon management and discovery web platform. Features authentication, category browsing, interactive map of stores, dynamic filtering, vendor plans, multi-language support, and responsive design.

title: Superadmin Administration Panel
description: I developed a full-featured admin dashboard in React to manage users, subscriptions, maps, products, and company data. The interface features dynamic sidebar navigation, form validation, file uploads, and statistical charts to visualize key metrics. User experience and modular structure were top priorities.

title: Kova Store
description: Responsible for creating social media content for Instagram and Facebook for Kova Store, a women's clothing showroom.

title: Patitas PetShop & Forraje
description: Responsible for creating social media content for Instagram and Facebook for a pet supply and feed store.

title: Movie App
description: Mobile app developed for the Computer Laboratory IV at UTN-FRBB. Built with Flutter and Dart, the app simulates a movie platform with a home screen, list view, and detail view. It connects to a custom Node.js + Express.js API hosted on Render, which fetches data from The Movie Database (TMDB). Designed for Android emulation (Pixel 6 - API 33) with responsive layout and API integration.

title: Digpatho Web App
description: Web application designed for pathologists to perform AI-assisted oncology analysis. It enables patient management, creation and administration of medical reports, and automatic report generation based on image analysis (Ki67, progesterone, estrogen, and HER2). Includes a complete authentication flow with email verification and password recovery, as well as multilingual support (Spanish, English, and Portuguese). Features a public section with company information. Developed as a functional MVP ready for market validation, in collaboration with backend (Python) and AI teams.

title: Depptö Quotation System
description:
Web application developed to optimize the quotation process for short-term rentals at Depptö. It allows quoting multiple properties dynamically, automatically retrieving pricing and descriptions from spreadsheets.

The system integrates with a Node.js and Express backend connected to Google Sheets to calculate stay rates in real time. Features client-side routing with React Router, responsive UI with Bootstrap, and a workflow-focused user experience to streamline sales operations.

title: Bastardo Digital Menu
description:
Interactive digital menu developed for Bastardo Coffee, accessible via QR code in-store. It allows customers to view products and updated prices in a clear and visually appealing way, improving the on-site experience.

Designed following the brand identity with a strong focus on usability. Currently fetches data from a JSON file, with upcoming integration with Google Sheets for dynamic price updates managed by the client. Future features include WhatsApp integration for direct ordering.

title: Bastardo Coffee
description:
End-to-end social media management for Bastardo Coffee, including content planning, visual asset creation (menu, QR, flyers), and reel production. Managed Meta Ads campaigns, community engagement, and event promotion.

Focused on brand growth, engagement, and strengthening digital presence.
